requirement_text:
# Scenario 2 (Brownfield): Add Custom Aliases and Link Expiration


On top of the existing URL shortener (built in Scenario 1), we now want two
enhancements:

1. Let users pick their own short code instead of always getting an
   auto-generated one (a "custom alias").
2. Let users optionally set an expiration time for a link, after which it
   should stop working.

This must not break any of the existing shorten/redirect/analytics behavior
for links that don't use these new options.

goals: Let a user choose their own short code (custom alias)
Let a user set an expiration (TTL) after which the link stops working
in_scope: custom_alias field on POST /api/shorten (validated, must be unique)
acceptance_criteria: custom_alias is honored when available and rejected with a clear error when taken
ttl_seconds causes the link to 410 after expiry
existing (non-aliased, non-TTL) links keep working exactly as before (regression safety)
